summary: Iteration 5 AI features (Smart Add + Ask Paavni AI chat) tested end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases passed (parse-expense categorizes 'milk purchase' into Milk Procurement Cost > Milk Purchase Cost > Purchase of Milk, expands 45k->45000 and 1.2L->120000; chat replies are grounded in real data - correctly cited Verka Dairy ~Rs.50,900 outstanding and Milk Procurement Cost May 2026 overrun; session history persists in ai_messages). Frontend Playwright flow verified: Dashboard Sparkle AI button opens 'Ask Paavni AI' modal with 4 suggestion chips, chip tap sends question and renders user + AI reply bubbles with actual figures, close works; Expense form (create mode) shows Smart add card, 'Fill with AI' prefilled Date=2026-10-08, Vendor=Verka Dairy, Main Category=Milk Procurement Cost and shows the 'Filled below - review and save.' confirmation note. No deprecated expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected in AI code paths.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_parse_expense catches all exceptions as 422 (acceptable per spec), but currently garbage input often still returns 200 with nulls because the model obliges with a JSON object. This matches spec expectations and is handled gracefully.
Chat history is loaded (last 50) and only the last 8 messages are included in the prompt - good token hygiene.
Consider sanitizing _finance_context to cap list length (already capped at 12 vendors / 12 categories / 8 months) - fine for current scale.
AI endpoints have no auth which matches the single-user spec; keep in mind for future multi-user migration.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on existing seeded data (Verka Dairy outstanding, Milk Procurement May 2026 budget overrun, Office Landlord recurring).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 AI features (Smart Add + AI Chat) are fully functional. /api/ai/parse-expense returns correctly mapped categories, /api/ai/chat is grounded in Mongo expense/dues/budget data and persists in ai_messages. Model used: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 via emergentintegrations.LlmChat. Keep test calls limited to avoid credit burn.
